headword: {机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}
gloss: armchair theory; impractical plan; pipe dream

definitions.explanation: An argument or plan that sounds coherent on paper but cannot work in practice because it ignores real conditions. Almost always used dismissively, of someone else's proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}だ。
⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎない→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: It is nothing more than armchair theorizing by someone who does not know the front line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えていない→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わるだろう。
examples.english: A plan that considers neither budget nor staffing will end up as an impractical theory.

notes:
Literally "empty argument on the desk" — {机上|きじょう} (on the desk) + {空論|くうろん} (empty theory). The image is of a plan drawn up at a desk by someone who has never been to the site.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}だ: that is armchair theory
- {机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎない→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to be nothing but armchair theory
- {机上|きじょう}の{空論|くうろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end up as an impractical idea

USAGE:
This is a blunt criticism. Directed at a superior or a client it will sound rude, so softer phrasings such as ⟦{現実的|げんじつてき}→現実的：04794_genjitsuteki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not realistic) are usually chosen in polite settings.
